WHOLE-FARM RESOURCE MODEL

Reserved capacity by week

Reservations and declared limits for this frozen snapshot. These are planning quantities, not measured use.

Run the numerical strategies to calculate weekly reservations. Declared capacity is 32 labour hours per week and 2,560 nursery sites.

WHOLE-FARM SIMULATION

Cost and margin comparison
Run the numerical strategies for this snapshot to calculate costs and simulated margins.

HOW DATA IS MADE

Rules you can inspect

These deterministic reference rules use no randomness or trained model. Every example opens the actual selected record.

Growing beds

The reference starts with sixteen sheltered beds, each 20 square metres. Bed names use four rows of four.

Formula and worked example
Inspect beds example
Crop recipes

Caixin, pak choi, kailan and lettuce each have declared nursery time, grow time, density, marketable yield, labour and input cost. These are biological assumptions for demonstrations.

Formula and worked example
Inspect recipes example
Existing batches

Eight reference batches occupy the first eight beds. Each crop has two batches; the second set harvests fourteen days after the first. Scenario delays and yields are applied after generation.

Formula and worked example
Inspect batches example
Historical demand

The reference generates twelve weekly values per crop. The repeating four-week pattern is an assumption, not measured seasonality. Trend is the total change over the observed period.

Formula and worked example
Inspect history example
Booked orders and prices

Four crops receive one fictional booked order per future week, for eight weeks. Volume and selling-price multipliers are independent. The generator books orders seven days before cutoff.

Formula and worked example
Inspect orders example
Opening inventory

The reference has one 5 kg caixin lot harvested the day before planning. Its expiry is two days after planning. The simulator tracks expiry and stock by lot.

Formula and worked example
Inspect inventory example
Available resources

The reference supplies 2,560 simultaneous nursery sites, 32 labour hours per week and SGD 2,200 for the whole planning horizon. Branch controls multiply labour and cash.

Formula and worked example
Inspect resources example
